title: Earthy Creamy Croatian Scamorza Pasta
description: A light and creamy Croatian dish featuring scamorza cheese, kombu cold extract, and satvik friendly ingredients, with a bitter earthy tone.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, make the kombu cold extract by soaking the kombu sheets in 1 cup of cold water for at least 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the chopped parsley to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Strain the kombu cold extract and add it to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to coat with the garlic and parsley mixture.
Slice the scamorza cheese and add it to the pasta, tossing to combine and melt the cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the earthy creamy Croatian scamorza pasta hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
